svg.title: Chapter III · THE SEALED SCROLL
svg.desc: Comic panel, chapter III · THE SEALED SCROLL. Pixel art: an unrolled parchment scroll with handwriting and a red wax seal, a quill and a lit candle on a wooden table. Voice agent turning Hindi, English and Marwari home-visit reports into sealed, structured health records. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, Sarvam Saaras v3.
